title: OpenAI names former NSA director Paul Nakasone to its board, saying he will help guard against attackers
summary: OpenAI said the appointment would help protect the company against increasingly sophisticated bad actors.

title: MemphisFlyer reports xAI will locate its supercomputer in Memphis, Tennessee
summary: MemphisFlyer reported that Elon Musk would site the xAI supercomputer in Memphis.

title: Turkish student arrested for allegedly using ChatGPT with a hidden camera and router to cheat on a university entrance exam
summary: A student in Isparta was arrested after allegedly feeding exam questions to ChatGPT through a hidden router, phone, earphone and button camera.

title: Apple announces Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024 for iOS 18, iPadOS 18 and macOS Sequoia
summary: Apple presented Apple Intelligence as a built-in feature of its next operating systems on 10 June 2024.

title: Spain appoints Ignasi Belda director general of its AI supervisory agency AESIA
summary: Ignasi Belda was appointed director general of the Spanish Agency for the Supervision of Artificial Intelligence on 12 June 2024.

title: Tesla in Autopilot mode reportedly hits a parked police vehicle in Fullerton, California
summary: A Tesla reportedly operating in Autopilot mode struck a parked police vehicle.

title: Mistral AI raises EUR 600 million at a EUR 5.8 billion valuation
summary: The round raised EUR 600 million (USD 645 million) and valued Mistral at EUR 5.8 billion (USD 6.2 billion).

title: NewsGuard audit finds leading AI chatbots repeated Russian disinformation in about a third of responses
summary: The audit found that leading AI models repeated Russian disinformation in about one-third of responses and cited fake Moscow news sites.

title: Nvidia passes Microsoft and Apple as the world's most valuable company, above USD 3.3 trillion
summary: Nvidia's market capitalisation exceeded USD 3.3 trillion on 18 June 2024.

title: Ilya Sutskever announces Safe Superintelligence Inc., co-founded with Daniel Levy and Daniel Gross
summary: Sutskever posted on X that the new company would aim to develop superintelligent AI safely.

title: Anthropic releases Claude 3.5 Sonnet
summary: Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet on 20 June 2024.

title: US Treasury moves closer to restricting US investment in Chinese AI and chip companies, Bloomberg reports
summary: Bloomberg reported that Treasury advanced rules on outbound investment in Chinese companies working on strategic technologies including AI.

title: Reports say a UK Department for Work and Pensions algorithm wrongly flagged about 200,000 people for housing benefit fraud checks
summary: About two-thirds of the claims the algorithm flagged were reportedly legitimate.

title: OpenAI says GPT-4o voice mode is delayed because it needs more time for safety testing, Washington Post reports
summary: OpenAI postponed its voice assistant to carry out further safety testing.

title: OpenAI warns it will block access to ChatGPT for users in China, Bloomberg reports
summary: Bloomberg reported that OpenAI warned it would cut access to its AI tools from China.

title: Scammers use a deepfake of Andy Lau to take NT$2.64 million from a fan in New Taipei City, media report
summary: A fan wired NT$2.64 million (about USD 81,000) after a video call with a deepfake of the Hong Kong entertainer, and an alleged scammer was arrested.
